strategyReview: The WEEKEND_HL_FUNDING_REVERSION_LONG signal continues to drive the system's profitability (210 live trades, 74% win, +$1.22 PnL). ONE_TOUCH_HIGH_EDGE_NO remains promising with clean live performance (4/4 wins, +$0.74) and positive shadow PnL despite a 45% win rate. In contrast, the funding-extreme family is failing: FUNDING_EXTREME_LONG has a 47% win rate and negative total return, with severe drag from AMZN and HYPE; FUNDING_EXTREME_SHORT is also flat to negative overall. The P/C ratio signals are stable but offer only marginal edges. The overall portfolio's realized gain of $2.14 and 63% win rate is heavily reliant on the weekend reversion engine.

failureClusters.theme: Funding Extreme Long on AMZN & HYPE
failureClusters.evidence: FUNDING_EXTREME_LONG on AMZN: 7 trades, 29% win, 5 stops, -$0.11; HYPE: 6 trades, 33% win, 4 stops, -$0.10. These assets do not reliably mean-revert after extreme negative funding.
failureClusters.recommendation: Keep AMZN permanently disabled; also disable HYPE for FUNDING_EXTREME_LONG. Consider a regime filter (e.g., spot above 7d SMA) before allowing new entries on any asset.

failureClusters.theme: PC Ratio Extreme Low on AMZN
failureClusters.evidence: 5 live AMZN trades with only 1 win (20%), 3 stops, -$0.11 PnL. The low P/C ratio extremes in AMZN options do not correlate with spot mean reversion under this signal.
failureClusters.recommendation: Keep AMZN permanently disabled for PC_RATIO_EXTREME_LOW; maintain the asset-specific block list. Explore the addition of IV confirmation, such as requiring amzn_opt_iv_30d to be in a low percentile, before re-enabling in the future.

newHypotheses.description: Shadow-test: WEEKEND_HL_FUNDING_REVERSION_LONG on MU. Enter long MU perp when mu_hl_funding_ann is in the bottom 15% of its 30-day range (deeply negative) AND mu_spot is within 3% of its 7-day low, aiming for mean reversion as funding normalizes.
newHypotheses.prediction: MU spot will rise 3-5% within 14 days as extreme funding pressure reverses.

newHypotheses.prediction: HOOD spot will appreciate 3-5% within 14 days as the extreme funding corrects.

newHypotheses.prediction: COIN spot will rise 3-5% within 14 days after extreme funding subsides.

hypothesisReviews.observation: BTC PM IV compression hypothesis (H-523) has an even 50% win rate over 11 tests, which is below the 60% promotion threshold. The pattern may be too sensitive to the chosen percentile threshold; I recommend allowing five more shadow tests and, if win rate still ≤55%, retiring this setup to avoid low-probability live deployment.

The promoted AMZN basis correction hypothesis (H-150) logged a single winning shadow test but has not triggered again. The underlying pattern (extreme basis < -0.8% with funding deeply negative) still looks theoretically strong; continue shadow-monitoring and allow any new trigger to enter live once the promotion gate (≥3 wins, >60%) is satisfied.

journalEntry: Nightly review confirms WEEKEND_HL_FUNDING_REVERSION_LONG as the primary alpha source. We propose three new shadow tests from ranked findings to broaden its eligible universe (MU, HOOD, COIN). Meanwhile, we reinforce the asset blocks for FUNDING_EXTREME_LONG on AMZN/HYPE and for PC_RATIO_EXTREME_LOW on AMZN, both of which have caused persistent drain. No parameter changes are warranted tonight; the failure clusters are better addressed by asset filtering than by global risk adjustments.
